create.name: Tony Stockwell
create.bio:
Tony Stockwell is an English medium who grew up in London's East End and first sat in a Spiritualist church as a teenager, where he found the work he has followed ever since. Over more than three decades he has given demonstrations of evidential and trance mediumship to audiences in Britain, North America and Australia, and he became familiar to many viewers through television series such as The Psychic Detective, Street Psychic and Psychic School. He has written four books for Hodder, among them Spirited and Walking with Angels.

These days much of his energy goes into training other mediums. He has taught for London's College of Psychic Studies and for Arthur Findlay College, keeps a teaching base called Soul Space in Billericay, Essex, and hosts residential weekends at country hotels around England. Online, he guides month-by-month Zoom programmes on trance and on trusting intuition. His manner is warm, practical and often funny, and he comes back regularly to Omega Institute in Rhinebeck, New York, to lead mediumship workshops.

books.title: Spirited
books.author: Tony Stockwell
books.description: His first book, a memoir of growing up with a sense of spirit in the East End and of the long apprenticeship that led him from a local Spiritualist church to stages and television studios. It also explains in everyday language how he understands communication with those who have died.

books.title: Embracing Eternity
books.author: Tony Stockwell
books.description: A follow-up to Spirited that gathers stories from his readings and demonstrations and reflects on what they suggest about life continuing after death. It is written for general readers rather than practising mediums.

books.title: Walking with Angels
books.author: Tony Stockwell
books.description: Accounts of moments when people felt guided or protected by spirit helpers, drawn from his own life and from people he has met through his work. He shares his view of guides and angelic presences and how ordinary people might sense them.

courses.title: The Awakening – Come Home to Yourself
courses.description: A ten-month online group that meets once a month on Zoom for a three-hour morning session. Each month takes a theme such as stillness, the inner voice, opening the heart and everyday intuition, building towards a settled spiritual practice.

courses.title: Residential Spiritual Workshop – Bailbrook House, Bath
courses.description: A weekend stay at a country-house hotel outside Bath with teaching sessions on developing mediumship and spiritual awareness. Meals and two nights' accommodation are included, with a cheaper rate for those who do not stay over.
courses.price: From £475 GBP sharing, £520 GBP single; non-residential £370 GBP

courses.title: Connecting with Your Soul Purpose and Spirit Guides
courses.description: A one-day in-person class at Circles of Wisdom in Methuen, Massachusetts. Participants work on sensing their guides and reflecting on what their life is asking of them.
courses.price: $125 USD ($99 USD if booked by 4 Nov 2026)

courses.title: Beyond the Seen: A Weekend of Exploring Psychic Detection with Tony Stockwell
courses.description: A two-day workshop at Circles of Wisdom in Massachusetts drawing on his television work as a psychic detective. Students practise psychic sensing exercises and learn how he approaches impressions from places and objects.
courses.price: $375 USD ($325 USD if booked by 5 Nov 2026)

courses.title: Mystical India: A Sacred Journey with Lauren Rainbow & Tony Stockwell
courses.description: A twelve-day group journey through Haridwar, Rishikesh, Agra and New Delhi, co-led with the medium Lauren Rainbow. Visits to sacred sites are combined with group teaching and spiritual practice.
courses.price: From $3,999 USD per person sharing, from $5,399 USD single

courses.title: Residential Spiritual Workshop – De Vere Cranage Estate, Cheshire
courses.description: A spring residential weekend at a country estate near Holmes Chapel in Cheshire. The programme centres on mediumship development in a small-group setting, with a day-guest option.

courses.title: The Prophetic Mind: 5-Day Retreat in British Columbia
courses.description: Five days at Crescent Beach in British Columbia exploring where mediumship and mysticism meet. Aimed at those already working with spirit who want to take their practice further; accommodation is extra.

courses.title: Residential Spiritual Workshop – De Vere Horsley Estate, Surrey
courses.description: An autumn weekend at a nineteenth-century mansion hotel in East Horsley, Surrey. Teaching focuses on strengthening the link with spirit, and there is a day rate for those not staying.

courses.title: Union of Souls Meditation
courses.description: A guided audio meditation to download, in which he leads the listener towards a felt sense of meeting loved ones in the spirit world.

courses.title: Past Life Embrace Meditation
courses.description: A downloadable guided meditation that invites the listener to reflect on earlier lives and what they may bring into this one.

free_resources.title: Ten Simple Steps to Connect with Loved Ones in Spirit
free_resources.description: A short article of everyday rituals for feeling close to people who have died, from keeping a small memory corner to writing letters and sitting quietly. No experience as a medium is assumed.

free_resources.title: An Invocation for Hope and Spiritual Abundance
free_resources.description: A short prayer-poem from his blog that returns again and again to gratitude, hope and courage. Readers can say it aloud as a simple daily devotion.
